name: Jason
overview: Jason was a Christian believer in Thessalonica who faced opposition from unbelieving Jews, as they attacked his house and brought him before the city rulers for harboring followers of Christ, who were accused of defying Caesar by proclaiming Jesus as another king. Despite this persecution, Jason's faithfulness is evident, and he is also mentioned by Paul in Romans as a kinsman, indicating a close relationship with the apostle and his ministry. These passages highlight Jason's role as a faithful supporter of the early church amid adversity.
